title: Health data hosting (France, HDS)
description: Preselected for the healthcare sector: keep it when the product, or the platform it runs on, stores personal health data for customers in France; decline it for a product outside France or without health data. It adds the French hosting rules of the Code de la santé publique, including the HDS certificate, to health-data-protection (EU).

sources.title: Légifrance, Code de la santé publique, Article L1111-8 (hosting of personal health data)
Légifrance, Code de la santé publique, Articles R1111-9 to R1111-11 (hosting activities, storage in the EU or EEA, certification, contract content)
